 Close Main Menu Loading… Open Main Menu November 12, 2026 War Eagle Wonderland brings holiday magic to Jordan-Hare
 Share Twitter Facebook Email AUBURN, Ala. — The magic of the holiday season is coming to Jordan-Hare Stadium this December as Auburn Athletics introduces War Eagle Wonderland, an immersive holiday experience that will transform Jordan-Hare Stadium into a festive destination filled with dazzling lights, seasonal sights and sounds, and a spectacular light and projection show celebrating the spirit of the Auburn Family.
 On select evenings throughout December, War Eagle Wonderland will invite fans and families to experience Jordan-Hare Stadium like never before, combining the traditions of Auburn with the wonder of the holiday season. From beautifully decorated spaces and festive holiday treats to exclusive behind-the-scenes access and a one-of-a-kind stadium light show, the experience promises unforgettable memories for Auburn fans of all ages.
 Guests will embark on a festive journey through some of Jordan-Hare Stadium’s most iconic spaces, including the Harbert Family Recruiting Center and Auburn Football locker room. Along the way, visitors will encounter Christmas trees, holiday decorations, seasonal music, interactive photo opportunities and special surprises, offering a unique opportunity to explore the home of Auburn Football in a completely new light. The experience will also feature a special photo opportunity with Santa Claus, holiday-themed concessions, hot chocolate and a festive holiday market offering exclusive Auburn Christmas and holiday-themed merchandise.
 The centerpiece of War Eagle Wonderland will be “Aubie’s Holiday Lights Miracle,” a spectacular holiday light and video presentation that brings the magic of Christmas to life through storytelling, music, stadium lighting and projections onto Pat Dye Field at Jordan-Hare Stadium.
 The heartwarming story follows Aubie as he discovers that the holiday lights at Jordan-Hare have gone dark. Determined to bring back the Christmas spirit, Aubie sets out on an adventure to rally Auburn student-athletes from across campus, discovering along the way that the true magic of the season comes from the Auburn Family coming together. The experience culminates in a dazzling celebration of lights, music and Auburn traditions.
 “Jordan-Hare Stadium holds a special place in the hearts of so many Auburn families, and we’re excited to create an opportunity for them to experience it in a whole new way,” said Rhett Hobart, Auburn Deputy Athletics Director and Chief Operating Officer. “War Eagle Wonderland brings together the traditions of Auburn and the magic of the holiday season, creating a special experience for families to make new memories in a place they already love. We hope it becomes a cherished holiday tradition for the Auburn Family for years to come.”
 Tickets and Event Information 
 Tickets for War Eagle Wonderland are $35 per person and $25 for youth 12 and under when purchased in advance, beginning Wednesday, Nov. 18 through the official Auburn Athletics VIP website HERE . Tickets purchased on the day of the event will be $45 per person.
 War Eagle Wonderland will be open from 5–8 p.m. CT on the following dates:
 Thursday, Dec. 3
 Friday, Dec. 4
 Sunday, Dec. 6
 Thursday, Dec. 10
 Friday, Dec. 11
 Saturday, Dec. 12
 Sunday, Dec. 13
 Thursday, Dec. 17
 Friday, Dec. 18
 Saturday, Dec. 19
 Whether continuing a cherished family tradition or creating a new one, War Eagle Wonderland offers the Auburn Family a special opportunity to celebrate the holiday season, experience the magic of Jordan-Hare Stadium and make memories that will last long after the holiday lights fade.
 This December, the magic of the holidays meets the magic of Auburn. War Eagle!
